summary: Approximately 752,618 km² and about 19.6 million people (2022), from Wikidata's Q953 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Zambia", at revision 1375224037, opens: "Zambia, officially the Republic of Zambia, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa. It is bordered to the north by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Tanzania to the northeast, Malawi to the east, Mozambique to the southeast, Botswana and Zimbabwe to the south, Namibia to the southwest, and Angola to the west. The capital city of Zambia is Lusaka, located in the south-central part of Zambia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 551 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1964 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Lusaka. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1953-08-01. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
